label: Место
description: Twelve-mission case drill for место (place, spot, seat) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form место stands as the subject after Это. Neuter nouns in -о take a bare nominative, and for inanimate neuters this form doubles as the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative место shifts to места. The negation нет requires the genitive, which for neuter -о nouns ends in -а with the stem stress preserved.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. Место takes the dative ending месту. The preposition к, marking movement toward a goal, governs the dative; neuter and masculine nouns share this ending.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of нашёл is место, identical to the nominative. For inanimate neuter nouns the accusative always matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The nominative место becomes местом. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental of the thing one is proud of, so the noun carries the instrumental ending -ом.

missions.phrase: На этом месте раньше был лес.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Место changes to месте after на. The prepositional marks location and never appears without a preposition; neuter -о nouns take -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is места. Neuter nouns form the nominative plural in -а, with the stress staying on the stem.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The form мест is the bare stem with a zero ending. Negation triggers the genitive; neuter -о nouns typically drop the ending entirely in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. Места becomes местам. The preposition по, here marking distribution across spots, governs the dative; -ам is the dative plural ending for all genders.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object места matches the nominative plural. Since место is inanimate, the accusative plural equals the nominative plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The plural места takes the ending местами. The preposition между governs the instrumental; -ами is the universal instrumental plural ending.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. Места shifts to местах after в. The prepositional plural ending -ах applies to all genders and always requires a preposition.
